title.narrative: People who have received essential health, nutrition, and population (HNP) services

comment.narrative: <p>Exceeded. Previously, consultations rather than beneficiaries were captured for the basic nutrition services, and births attended by skilled health personnel were overestimated. The data are adjusted according to the achievement under the program.</p>

title.narrative: RBF facilities receiving timely RBF payment on the basis of verified results every quarter

comment.narrative: <p>Not Achieved. Payments were consistently delayed and not made within the stipulated time. </p>

title.narrative: Completion of Star rating" assessment of PHC facilities as per the two-year cycle

comment.narrative: <p>Not Achieved. The final cycle of assessment was not undertaken in time. </p>

title.narrative: PHC facilities with 3- Star Ratings and Above

comment.narrative: <p>Not achieved. The third round of assessment was not been conducted, the latest and final data is from 2018.</p>

title.narrative: Completion of annual capacity building activities compared to agreed annual plans
RHMTs required biannual data quality audits (DQA) for LGAs that meets national DQA standards
RHMTs conduct quarterly supportive supervision visits for the LGAs that meets national supervision standards and is reported in DHIS2
Health facilities with continuous availability of the tracer medicines in the past year based on MoHCDGEC medicine list
Pregnant women attending 4 or more ante-natal care (ANC) visits
ANC attendees receiving at least 2 doses of intermittent preventive treatment (IPT2) for malaria
Proportion of children 12-59 months receiving at least one dose of Vitamin A during the previous year

comment.narrative: <p>Achieved. By December 2020, 160 facilities were confirmed functional. Since the government continued with refurbishment, more facilities became functional by program closing, though the actual numbers could not be verified. </p>

title.narrative: Share of health in total government budget
Councils with unqualified opinion in the annual external audit report
LGAs with functional Council Health Service Boards
Completeness of quarterly HMIS data entered in DHIS by LGA (by the end of month after quarter ends)
